title: Emails
slide_intent: Demonstrate how to organize a narrow email around a shopping decision while retaining recognizable brand ingredients across product categories.
strategic_value: An offer-led food email and a beauty email can use different palettes and image treatments under the same identity.
demonstration: Two tall email mockups pair headline, imagery and shopping actions differently. The first uses a green offer button and a food photograph. The second uses a berry-colored arrow above beauty products and outlined actions.
practical_value: Choose a single prominent offer or a set of product choices according to the job of the message.

content_islands.name: Food offer
content_islands.spec: Place the cream email at left with a small wordmark, prominent offer, dark action and food image.

content_islands.name: Beauty selection
content_islands.spec: Place the second email beside it. Use the arrow and hero product at the top, then group product thumbnails with their individual actions.
